privacy: Local files only. Your document stays in this browser.
drop: Drop an Excel workbook here to export a worksheet
invalid: Choose a readable XLSX, XLSM, XLTX, or XLTM workbook. It may be damaged or use an unsupported feature.
protected: Encrypted workbooks and legacy Excel files are not supported here. Save an unencrypted XLSX copy and try again.
resource: This document needs more memory than this browser can provide. Close other tabs or try another device.
engineUnavailable: The exporter could not load. Check your connection and try again.
copyFailed: Unable to copy the data. Select it in the output area or download the exported file.
firstRowHeader: Use the first row as a Markdown header
rangeHint: For example, A1:D20. Leave empty for the worksheet’s data range.
invalidRange: Enter a cell or rectangle such as A1 or A1:D20 within the Excel worksheet.
missingCached: {count} formula cells have no saved result and are exported as blanks.
empty: The selected area contains no saved values or formulas.
formatNote: CSV and TSV quote separators, quotes, and line breaks. JSON is an array of rows, including the first row; blank cells are null. Markdown can use the first row as a header or add an empty header. Downloads use UTF-8.
valuesNote: Formatted text follows supported number formats, including dates and leading zeros; locale-dependent formats may differ from Excel. Stored values keep numbers and booleans; dates use Excel serial numbers. Text values remain text. Spreadsheet errors remain visible strings.
scopeNote: Only saved cell values are exported. Formulas are not recalculated; missing saved results become blanks. Hidden rows and columns are included. Merged cells are not expanded. Charts, images, comments, macros, and styling are not exported. The default range contains saved values or formulas; blank cells inside it are kept.
